Chase.history: up to 7 years, depending on account type
steps: Sign in at chase.com
Open the main menu and choose Statements & documents
Pick the account and year
Click the open or save icon next to a statement
Chase.bulk: No for statements: one PDF per month; transaction activity can be downloaded for a date range as CSV or Quicken/QuickBooks files.

Amex.history: about 2 years of transactions online; older archived statements can be requested
steps: Sign in at americanexpress.com
Open Statements & Activity
Pick a billing period or date range
Use the download option and choose a file format
Amex.bulk: Partly: transactions can be exported for a range of billing periods at once; statement PDFs are one per month.

Citi.history: 24 months online for bank accounts; older statements by request
steps: Sign in at citi.com
Open the account
Go to Statements
Choose a statement and download the PDF
Citi.bulk: No: one PDF per statement; older statements must be requested first.

Capital One.history: up to 7 years for active accounts (paperless enrollment required)
steps: Sign in at capitalone.com or in the Capital One app
Open the account
Choose View statements
Pick a month and download the PDF
Capital One.closes: typically by the 6th of each month for bank accounts

Discover.history: up to 7 years of card statements for paperless customers; 24 months of transactions
steps: Sign in at discover.com
Open Statements
Pick a billing period
Download the statement PDF
Discover.bulk: No: one PDF per billing period.

Bank of America.history: up to 7 years online; older copies via Request Statements
steps: Sign in to Bank of America Online Banking
Open the account, then the Statements & Documents tab
Pick a statement and download it
Bank of America.bulk: No for statements: one PDF per month; transactions (up to 12 months for cards) can be downloaded for financial software.

Wells Fargo.history: up to 7 years for deposit accounts; up to 2 years for credit cards
steps: Sign on to Wells Fargo Online
Open Statements & Documents
Pick the account and statement
Download the PDF
Wells Fargo.bulk: No: statements download one at a time; account activity can be downloaded for a date range (up to 18 months for deposit accounts, 90 days for cards).

steps: On iPhone, open Wallet, tap Apple Card, then Card Balance; or sign in at card.apple.com
Open Statements
Download a monthly statement PDF, or choose Export Transactions
Pick a date range and format (CSV, OFX, QFX)
Apple Card.bulk: Yes for transactions: export a date range at once; statement PDFs are one per month.

steps: Sign in at barclaysus.com or in the Barclays US app
Open Activity & Statements, then Statements
Pick a statement and download it
Barclays.bulk: No for statements: one PDF per month; transactions can be downloaded for financial software from Activity & Statements.

US Bank.history: up to 7 years of e-statements; up to 3 years of transaction downloads
steps: Sign in to U.S. Bank online banking (or the app: Statements & docs)
Choose the document type and account
Change the year for older statements
Select a statement to view or download
US Bank.bulk: Partly: transaction history (up to 3 years) downloads in one file from online banking, not the app; statements are one per month.

steps: Sign in at synchrony.com or in the MySynchrony app (Synchrony Bank: synchrony.com/banking)
Open Statements (bank accounts: Inbox, then Statements)
Pick a statement and download the PDF

PNC.history: up to 7 years for checking and savings; up to 4 years for credit cards
steps: Sign in to PNC Online Banking
Open the account, then Statements and Documents
Choose a statement and select View PDF to save it
Sign in to TD Bank Online Banking
Open Statements
Pick the account and statement
Download the PDF
Sign in at ally.com
Open the account
Find statements in the account documents, or use the download icon in Transaction History
Choose CSV or Quicken (QFX) for transactions
Ally.bulk: Partly: transaction history downloads as one CSV or QFX file; statements are one per month.

Schwab.history: up to 10 years of statements; up to 4 years of transaction history
steps: Sign in at schwab.com or in the Schwab app
Go to Accounts, then Statements & Tax Forms
Pick the account and document
Download the PDF
Schwab.bulk: Partly: transaction history can be exported for a date range; statements are one PDF each.

HSBC.history: up to 7 years for eligible deposit accounts
steps: Log on to HSBC Personal Internet Banking
Open eStatements
Pick the account and statement
Download or print it
HSBC.bulk: No: one statement at a time.

steps: Log in at fidelity.com
Open Statements under Accounts & Trade or Documents
Pick the account and statement period
Download the PDF
Fidelity.bulk: No: one PDF per statement period.

Vanguard.history: transaction downloads cover the past 18 months; statements stay online at least 13 months
steps: Log in at vanguard.com
Open History, statements, and taxes
Download a statement PDF, or download transaction history
Vanguard.bulk: Partly: up to 18 months of transactions download in one file; statements are one PDF each.

steps: Log in at sofi.com or in the SoFi app
On the Banking home page, open Statements
Pick the month and year and download the PDF
SoFi.closes: within the first 5 business days of each month

steps: Sign in to Navy Federal online banking
Choose Statements from the menu (app: More, then Account and Tax Statements)
Pick a statement and save the PDF
Log on at usaa.com or in the USAA app
Open your profile menu, then My Documents
Filter by account and widen the date range for older items
Open a statement and download it
USAA.bulk: No: one document at a time.

steps: Open the Monzo app
On Home, tap the three dots under your card, then Bank statements
Pick a date range and format
Download or share the file
Monzo.bulk: Yes: one statement can cover any date range you pick.

steps: Open the Revolut app
On Home, tap Accounts and pick the currency
Tap More (...), then Statement
Choose a timeframe and PDF or Excel, then Generate
Revolut.bulk: Yes: one statement can cover a custom timeframe, starting no earlier than the account opening date.

steps: Sign in at wise.com or in the Wise app
Click your initials, then Statements and reports, then Statement
Choose the currencies and time period
Pick a format, confirm with your password, and download
Wise.bulk: Yes: up to 365 days per statement, and several currencies at once as a zip; longer periods need multiple downloads.
